units.english: To solo this quest you need to play correctly in 2 ways. First of all you need to not die to breath, that means before you aggro the boss you should have full breath. The second thing to be aware of is that you need to kick EVERY frostbolt you can and use evasion after a kick. Most of his damage will be from frostbolts. Remember you can vanish and try again 5 mins later, aslong as you don't die to breath.
units.translation: 要獨立地完成這個任務 你需要正确地玩{number_a}首先,你需要不要死在呼吸中, 意思是,在你向老板道歉之前, 你應該有完整的呼吸。 第二件事是,你需要踢遍所有你能做到的霜杯, 并在踢完之後用逃避。 他的大部分損傷將來自霜堡。 記住, 你可以消失, 重新試試 。{number_b}等一會兒,你不會死在呼吸。
